authority: Original PR #1 alpha/terminal-wealth-first continuation. User explicitly authorizes rewriting opportunity discovery and ownership while preserving causal next-session execution, frozen inputs, costs and execution constraints.

committed_offensive_attribution.finding: Broad-scope losses were dominated by opportunity cost, and the existing score sometimes identified later winners before committed ownership could act.

alpha_decay_leader.finding: Campaign-specific displacement materially improves full-history wealth in all three scopes, but its 2023-2025 union wealth remains below control and its drawdown is materially worse.

native_full_cap_failure.finding: Keeping native ownership while removing account de-risking damages broad-universe capital before the decisive 2025 handoff. The later winners are still captured at similar campaign percentage returns, implying entry/opportunity quality is the next bottleneck.

economic_hypothesis: The old scalar score admits too many choppy broad-universe trends when exposure is high. A deterministic causal trend-quality score that requires directional efficiency, follow-through near/new highs and multi-session persistence should concentrate capital in cleaner leadership trends while preserving the high-exposure campaign lifecycle that already improved full-history alpha.

treatment.ownership_base: Use the already tested offensive_alpha_decay_displacement lifecycle unchanged except that every admission, incumbent-decay comparison and challenger comparison consumes trend_quality instead of techquant.features.score. Do not change its two-position capacity, observed-cash vacancy funding, security exits, one-way retirement, blocked-sale retry or no-same-close-sale-proceeds semantics.

trend_quality_components.directional_efficiency: For session D and each symbol, using adjusted closes through D only, compute positive 40-session log price progress divided by the sum of absolute one-session log moves over the same 40-session path. Require the full Config.slow=40 observations; nonpositive progress or invalid denominator yields zero/nonfinite quality component.
trend_quality_components.follow_through: Current close divided by the highest close observed in the preceding Config.slow=40 sessions excluding D. This directly rewards causal proximity to or extension above the prior 40-session high.
trend_quality_components.persistence: Fraction of the latest Config.fast=10 sessions, including D, whose close is above the existing causal EMA20 from trend_book.price_signals.

treatment.cross_sectional_transform: On each session D, among causally ready symbols with finite component values, convert each of the three components independently to deterministic ordinal percentiles in (0,1], breaking exact ties by symbol identifier. No future observations, labels, fitted coefficients or whole-sample ranks are used.
treatment.quality_score: Geometric mean of the three current-session component percentiles: (efficiency_pct * follow_through_pct * persistence_pct) ** (1/3). All three components participate symmetrically; there are no fitted or searched weights.
treatment.eligibility: Keep the candidate1 causal price/trend admission gate: fresh/ready quote, observed_trend entry, close above EMA20, positive 5-session momentum, broad market admission open, no security break, not already held and not retired. Replace only the old score-positive/ranking input with finite positive trend_quality.
treatment.campaign_reference: Freeze the selected symbol's trend_quality at the close that requests its vacancy fill and bind it to the campaign only once actual inventory is observed.
treatment.displacement: With a full intact book, an incumbent is eligible for one-way displacement only after its current trend_quality falls below its own frozen admission trend_quality and the strongest currently eligible challenger has trend_quality strictly above that same frozen incumbent reference. No new threshold, ratio, confirmation day or review clock is introduced.
treatment.execution: Unchanged close decision / next-session execution, sells before buys, cash-only long-only, no leverage or shorting, prior-volume liquidity, board lots, T+1, fees, slippage and price-limit handling.

structural_difference_from_rejected_work: Not the old ranking learner: no labels, ridge/ML fit, expanding-window model, future target or learned weight exists.
Not a reweighting of the old techquant score: the treatment constructs a new deterministic path-quality signal from price geometry and cross-sectional percentiles.
Not nearby EMA/lookback tuning: all horizons are existing Config.fast=10, Config.slow=40 and existing EMA20; this contract freezes one formula and runs no horizon grid.
Not a new ownership threshold search: it reuses candidate1's already tested campaign-reference lifecycle and changes only the alpha discovery signal source.

measurement.primary_objective: maximize mean(log(terminal wealth)) across the three fixed scopes
measurement.secondary_objective: maximize minimum terminal wealth across the three fixed scopes
measurement.promotion_rule: Advance only if the fixed selector improves mean-log wealth and minimum wealth, improves at least one broad scope, and joint optical-leader removal terminal wealth remains above 1.0. Improvement must be economically material before full formal validation.
measurement.failure_rule: If rejected, preserve the failure and move to a substantively different discovery architecture. Do not search component weights, horizons, percentile cutoffs, displacement margins or position counts.

prohibitions: No future label/high/return in a decision
No neighboring parameter or weight grid
